OpenWarp advice · 1 finding

CPU offload · qwen2.5:14b                                       confidence: high
  Part of the model is running on the CPU, slowing every token.

  Evidence
    Placement      7%/93% CPU/GPU   1.1 GB of 15.7 GB on CPU
    Context        32,768 tokens    above the 8,192 threshold
    Loaded models  1
    Other VRAM     2,315 MiB
  Likely cause     KV cache for the long context

  Fix (pick one)
    1. Shorter context     /set parameter num_ctx 8192   (inside ollama run)
    2. Quantize KV cache   sudo systemctl edit ollama
                           add under [Service]:
                             Environment="OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1"
                             Environment="OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0"
                           sudo systemctl restart ollama

  Why
    A partial CPU offload is slow: every token must pass through the layers left
    in system RAM, which the CPU computes with far less memory bandwidth than
    the GPU, and activations cross PCIe between CPU and GPU layers.

  Source  Song et al., "PowerInfer: Fast LLM Serving with a Consumer-grade GPU," SOSP 2024, arXiv:2312.12456

Advice only. OpenWarp did not change any settings.
